gtopdb_row_and_reference: GtoPdb ligand 35, Antagonist at D4, ref PMID 12388666
checked_at_source: PubMed abstracts: PMID 12388666 (Millan 2002, part I) is a binding study with no functional measure; its companion PMID 12388667 (Newman-Tancredi 2002, part II, GTPgammaS) reports that at hD4 "bromocriptine was inactive" (no agonism), intermediate efficacy at hD2S
finding: context-dependent and partly a family-expansion artefact: ChEMBL's agonist statement is at the D2-like family level and does not hold at D4 (inactive as agonist); antagonism at D4 is not shown in the abstracts read (full text not read). Kept ambiguous
which_side: neither established; ChEMBL's D4 INCREASE is not supported

module_change: none: the module already flags complex/family-level ChEMBL targets as not subunit-specific (repurposing_search limits); a per-subtype rule would be a new method, not a defect fix
